description: What the webview may ask the shell to do.

permissions.comment: HTTPS anywhere; plain HTTP only to a server on a private network, which is where a warehouse's own Spork runs: the warehouse wifi (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16), Tailscale (100.64/10 and *.ts.net), a .local name, or this device. Not every HTTP address, so a script that got into the webview can't send anything to the internet in the clear. IP addresses are written as regular-expression groups: URL patterns rewrite a bare 10.* as an IPv4 address before matching.
